response: Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum, We're pirates, we're bold, we're a dangerous crew, We'll plunder and pillage, from morning to night, With our cutlasses sharp and our hearts set on fight. We'll hoist the black flag and sail on the high seas, Searching for treasure, beneath the bright sun, We'll drink and we'll dance and we'll sing, As we plunder and pillage, and make our fortune grow. So here's to the pirates, the bravest of the brave, May their spirits never be broken, nor their courage be staved, For they're the true heroes, of the golden age of sail, And their legend will live on, for all time to hail.
